title: Quote: show the total cost over the term
description: The quote panel wants a "total cost" line. The quote endpoint now also returns `total_cost_cents`: all monthly rates plus the down payment and the one-off costs, in cents like every other amount. Test added.

defects.explanation: For business offers the rate from the calculator is net, but LeasingTerms holds the down payment and extra costs gross (as dealers enter them), so the total adds a net rate to gross amounts and is neither the net nor the gross total.
